player_prompt.intro:
Ya aci piny tiim kuɛny thiɛr ku dealer.
Ya kɛm kuɛny aya ɣet tiop 21 kɛm aya kɛnɛ ku bɛn.
Alɔŋ ya tiɔp, luɔɔ '[Hit]' kɛn aya tiɔp kuɛny anɔŋ '[Stand]' kɛn aya kɛm.
J/Q/K = 10 tiɔp; A = 11 anɔŋ 1, ee yen aya ɣet.
